item.title: Three Days & Three Sales Make $1.29 Million At Everard
item.description: SAVANNAH, GA. — Three days of auction action at Everard Auctions & Appraisals led to 1,339 lots crossing the block between February 24-26. The sale totaled $1,292,308, landing at the high end of the $938,150-$1,468,890 estimate.
